disclaimer.body: We Care 4 ‘all’ is an independent healthcare consultancy and patient coordination service. We do not provide medical advice or treatment, nor do we own or operate any medical facility. All medical services are delivered exclusively by licensed physicians and accredited healthcare institutions chosen by the patient. Treatment outcomes, timelines, and costs are determined solely by the treatment provider. Cost estimates are indicative and non-binding. internationalPatientsPage.vettingTitle: How We Vet Our Partner Hospitals
internationalPatientsPage.vettingSub: Accreditation is the foundation of trust in cross-border care. We hold ourselves — and every hospital we work with — to a documented standard, not just a reputation.

euroCert.d: Our platform and empanelment process are EURO CERT accredited, reflecting independently reviewed quality and safety standards.

credentialing.d: Every partner hospital's specialists, infrastructure, and accreditations are verified and recorded before empanelment — not taken on their word.

monitoring.d: Partnerships are reviewed periodically, not just at onboarding — standards need to hold up over time, not just on day one.

records.d: Accreditation and specialty information for each partner hospital is available to you before you commit to treatment there.

internationalPatientsPage.independentPara: We are an independent healthcare consultancy, created to guide patients — not promote institutions. We work directly with experienced specialists and ethically managed hospitals, so we can recommend treatment purely on clinical appropriateness, safety, and affordability.
ourRole: Act solely in the patient's interest
Ensure transparency across treatment planning and execution
internationalPatientsPage.independentFooter: We are accountable to patients, not hospital networks.
internationalPatientsPage.differentTitle: How Our Care Model Is Different
internationalPatientsPage.differentPara: Unlike facilitation models built into hospital referral systems, we follow a patient-centric coordination approach.
careModel: We do not operate as a hospital sales channel
We are not driven by institutional occupancy or revenue targets
Treatment recommendations are independent of commercial incentives
internationalPatientsPage.differentFooter: This lets us focus on medical necessity, cost rationalization, and continuity of care.
internationalPatientsPage.feeSub: International patients see varying pricing structures depending on the facilitation model used. In some markets, coordination costs are embedded and hidden inside hospital billing. We do it differently.
feeStructure: Our professional service fee is 25%, disclosed upfront
The fee is collected directly from the patient
Hospitals and specialists are paid only for medical services rendered
No bundled referral costs or undisclosed markups
internationalPatientsPage.feeFooter: By separating our professional coordination fee from hospital billing, patients get greater cost clarity and better affordability.
internationalPatientsPage.journeySub: From your first message to us through to follow-up care back home — here's exactly what to expect.

01.d: Share your medical reports with us. Our team reviews your case and connects you with the right specialist for an initial opinion.

02.d: Once the specialist confirms a plan, we prepare a transparent cost estimate covering treatment, stay, and our coordination fee.

03.d: We issue your medical visa invitation letter and help you plan flights, so paperwork never holds up your care.

04.d: Airport pickup, interpreter, and accommodation are arranged before you land. We accompany you through hospital admission.

05.d: Your treatment proceeds under the specialist's care, with our team coordinating logistics and checking in throughout.

faqs.q: How do I get a medical opinion before deciding to travel?
faqs.a: Share your existing medical reports and scans with us online. We connect you with an appropriate specialist for a video consultation so you have clarity on your treatment plan before committing to travel.

faqs.q: Is the total cost disclosed before I travel?
faqs.a: Yes. Once your treatment plan is confirmed, you receive a written estimate covering hospital charges and our coordination fee separately, so there's no ambiguity about what you're paying for.

faqs.q: Do you help with the medical visa?
faqs.a: Yes — we issue the hospital invitation letter you'll need for your visa application and guide you through the documentation.

faqs.q: Can a family member or attendant travel with me?
faqs.a: Yes, accompanying attendants are common. We factor this into accommodation and travel planning, and attendant visas follow the same invitation-letter process.

faqs.q: What happens if I need urgent transfer to a different hospital?
faqs.a: For time-critical cases, we're empanelled with Air Ambulance services for medically supervised transfers — see Emergency Transfers below.

faqs.q: Do you provide interpreter support during hospital visits?
faqs.a: Yes, language assistance is arranged for consultations and hospital stays so nothing is lost in communication with your care team.

internationalPatientsPage.legalDisclaimerText: We Care 4 'all' is an independent healthcare consultancy and patient coordination service. We do not provide medical advice or treatment, nor do we own or operate any medical facility. All medical services are delivered exclusively by licensed physicians and accredited healthcare institutions chosen by the patient. Treatment outcomes, timelines, and costs are determined solely by the treatment provider. Cost estimates are indicative and non-binding. Professional service fees relate only to coordination and support services and are disclosed separately. No medical outcomes are guaranteed.
